chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Sweden in 1980: Bo Stenhammer's festival
summary: Bo Stenhammer booked her for a Swedish festival with a good band behind her. It was her only Swedish trip, in 1980, soon after her illness, and the organisers bent over backwards.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Who booked you in there? Was it a tour? I mean, were you alone?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
They put a band behind you?
Yes and a good one. I went over there for a festival and he had Bo Stenhammer. Has it every year. They wanted me to come back this year but with me being sick, I didn't. But I still ...
How many times did you go to Sweden?
The one time. And when was that? How long ago was that?
Yes. Let me see, it was '80.
After you had been in the hospital?
No, I came back, and let's see, you know, now I'll have to get my book and look and see.
Well, it's not too serious. But it was that recent.
Yes, it was that recent because, you know, they knew I wasn't feeling too good. And they'd bend over backwards.
